description: Find sauna, cold plunge and contrast therapy studios in the United States near a city, ZIP code or metro area. Returns studios ranked by Contrast Therapy Finder (verified listings first, then rating), with services, Google rating and a link to each studio's page with hours, prices, temperatures and booking.

limit.description: How many studios to return. Default 8.

location.description: City and state ("Austin, TX"), a 5-digit ZIP code, or a metro name ("Dallas").

service.description: What the person wants. contrast = has both a sauna and a cold plunge. Default any.

name: find_studios
title: Find sauna & cold plunge studios
